raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.5.0"

package:
  name: kiwisolver
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/k/kiwisolver/kiwisolver-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d4193f3d9dc3f6f79aaed0e5637f45d98850ebf01f7ca20e69457f3e8946b66a

build:
  number: 0
  skip: match(python, "<3.10")
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --no-build-isolation -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - cppy >=1.3.0
    - setuptools >=61.2
    - setuptools-scm >=3.4.3
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - kiwisolver
      pip_check: true

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: A fast implementation of the Cassowary constraint solver
  homepage: https://github.com/nucleic/kiwi

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - blink1073
    - licode
    - MatthieuDartiailh
    - sccolbert
    - tacaswell
    - ocefpaf
    - fhoehle
